# govengers/storage

> Blob storage for govengers services behind one interface: storage.Store (put with content type, metadata and size cap, get with byte range, stat, delete, paged list), backends for S3-compatible object stores (AWS SDK v2, multipart, copy, presigned URLs, path style), the filesystem (os.Root, atomic writes) and memory, helpers for untrusted uploads (key validation, LimitReader, streaming SHA-256, content type sniffing with an allowlist), an ObservedStore with Prometheus and OpenTelemetry adapters, and the conformance suite storagetest.

- Module: `github.com/govengers/storage`, Go 1.26, Apache 2.0.
- Packages: `storage` (Store, Copier, Presigner, Copy, PresignGet, PresignPut, ValidateKey, ValidatePrefix, ValidateMetadata, ValidateContentType, LimitReader, NewSHA256Reader, DetectContentType, ObservedStore, Observer, ClassifyError), `s3adapter`, `filesystem`, `memory`, `prometheusadapter`, `oteladapter`, `storagetest` (Run).
- Standards: govengers/standards, `library` profile.
- Rules of thumb: the application chooses keys, never the client; detect the content type from the bytes, cap the size with PutOptions.MaximumSize, record size, type and digest on the owning database row; use storage.Copy and storage.PresignGet/PresignPut instead of type assertions; a presigned PUT checks nothing, verify the stored object; serve untrusted uploads as attachments.
